statement: Owner reports that the unrealized profit from the prior bullish move was fully given back.
interpretation: The main failure in this phase was not initial direction selection but profit protection and re-entry/add discipline after the edge had already paid. The system continued to search for additional long entries during/after squeeze payout instead of switching into protection mode.
canonical_lessons: Separate signal-generation, payout, and protection phases.
After a large favorable move, the objective changes from maximizing entry exposure to protecting realized/unrealized gains.
Do not permit new adds solely from constructive CVD/OI while price repair is deteriorating or while the move is already squeeze-extended.
CVD/OI are context filters, not execution permission. Price must confirm the retest/reclaim.
A profitable thesis can still become a losing management process if full profit giveback is allowed.
Future playbook should define a maximum allowed giveback from peak unrealized PnL before mandatory de-risking. Exact threshold must be validated and should not be hard-coded from one case.

model_change_request.required_transition: Once payout evidence appears (e.g. strong favorable displacement with short-liquidation dominance / squeeze characteristics), default mode becomes PROTECT rather than ADD.
model_change_request.anti_revenge_rule: After large profit giveback, do not immediately increase risk to recover the lost profit. Require a fresh setup and fresh invalidation.
